summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on aggregating data for virtual facilities that lack recorded user sessions, particularly concerning models used in Finland. It was determined that standard aggregation methods fail when no sessions are present.

To address this, a proposed workaround involves inserting one 'dummy' session per time period into an intermediate temporary table for every facility lacking sessions but having associated models. This dummy session would have `base frequency = 1` and `dwell time = 0`, ensuring the model can process the data structure.

The participants confirmed that this method, while unconventional, should allow the necessary calculations (including impressions) to proceed, as the subsequent full reload will normalize the data.
decisions: A workaround involving inserting dummy sessions into a temporary table was agreed upon to enable traffic aggregation for facilities without recorded sessions.
